adaptedOnly.rationale: Octane public type contract plus @ts-expect-error negative controls; no upstream typings twin.

permittedTransformations.rule: TypeScript printer output must remain structurally identical
import * as React from 'react' / React.useState become import { useState } from 'octane' / useState
optional /** @jsxImportSource octane */ is stripped before structural compare
Matching @ts-expect-error controls must reject the same invalid call shapes on both sides when present; adapted-only public-api.test.ts carries Octane-surface controls
